name: The North Cove
atmosphere: Work, not romance: crates under tarps, trodden paths, nobody talks loudly.
body:
## On first entering

> [!readaloud] The path ends at a shingle beach the tide has half
> swallowed. Between two rock needles lies a boat without a name,
> and further back, where the cliff recedes, smoke hangs in the air.

## Who is here

- Fenn and four people who sail for him
